title: Attio integrations row
description: A centred dark pinstriped band about integrations: a navy badge, a white 40px heading, a grey line and a small arrow button over a row of 96px rounded graphite app tiles with a faint inner light. The row fades out at both edges and drifts 40px sideways as the band scrolls past.
notes: forces the dark palette and marks itself data-header-tone="dark" for the attio header
